skill_name: Describe a famous historical figure in 200 words or less.
workflow: Marie Curie was a Polish-born scientist whose groundbreaking research in radiation and radioactivity led to her becoming the first woman to win a Nobel Prize and the only woman to win the award in two different fields: physics and chemistry. Born to a teacher and a principal, Marie showed an early interest in mathematics and physics and would go on to attend one of the few educational institutions in Europe at the time that allowed for women.
